name: Cairns Network Services
summary: Cairns/Far North QLD dialup + ISDN ISP (CairnsNet Pty Ltd), first flat-rate provider in Cairns; ISP side sold to GetOnIt ~Dec 2005 (Cairns Net Services/AussieWide); later web-hosting/domain arm moved customers to Planet Ozi ~Sep 2017.

events.details: Web-hosting/domain customer base moved to Planet Ozi; cairns.net.au served 200 through May 2017 then began 301-redirecting from 11 Sep 2017.
